annotations.title: Show a doc in the chat

description: Open a doc inside the chat as a live view of the page. In hosts that render MCP Apps (claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Claude mobile) the doc appears in the conversation; the person can read it, switch on Edit text, click any heading or paragraph, retype it and save, and the share link shows the change at once. Call it when they ask to see, preview, check or hand-edit a doc, and whenever they paste a doc.farm link into the conversation: open it with show_doc first, then answer. host_html_content, patch_doc and duplicate_doc already show this view after they run, so do not call show_doc straight after them. Text-only hosts get the share link.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

doc_name.description: Name of the doc (fuzzy-matched). Pass this or slug.

slug.description: The doc's slug or share URL.
